text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The summer training camp to hone our 
skills begins tomorrow. Preparations were 
already complete, but regardless, she 
continued preparing meticulously late
into the night."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Oaks,
Verxina felt strongly that 
she had to grow even more than 
Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...To the point where she's overthinking 
it a bit. In order to support her—
choice_data_list: I need to make the training menu e...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...It looks like everyone really has
gone 
home. Training camp does start tomorrow, 
after all...)
choice_data_list: We need to refine the menu even mo...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, I... can't afford to rest. 
Because...—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh! Wait, is that...—)

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Gentile-san. We've already 
finished harrowing over there, so...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Thank you. You may head home for the 
day now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I must apologize for causing trouble each 
time. Smoothing over my tracks must be 
quite an ordeal, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
N-No... It's my job,
after all. Besides... 
I enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
The hoofprints you leave carve deeper
with 
each passing day... Watching your growth 
from the sidelines... is truly thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...Having watched over Umamusume for
many 
years... I've seen that no matter how 
strong a girl is, she never slacks off, 
putting in relentless effort."

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Even among them, your dedication... is 
second to none. ...Why do you push 
yourself so hard?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey.
I truly cannot understand this no 
matter what."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Does one truly need a reason to 'try 
hard'?"

text_block_list.name: Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest. That is the one and only 
duty the strong must uphold."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I will place myself 'there.' That is why 
I strive for strength."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I can clearly see the view from the 
summit where I ought to stand. All I must 
do is strive earnestly toward it...
To put 
it simply—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I merely become the person I wish to be. 
—There is more to follow, so excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Aba, no way, no way! I woke up early 
for this, after all."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Haa...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, I can't be getting tired at this 
level... She had so much more to spare...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: One more!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Verxina-san... Have you been doing this 
the whole time...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...She's working so hard. So, so hard..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—I shall prove to you that there is no 
such thing as "definitely impossible."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "I used to think so too."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"‘I can do it! I can, I can do it, I've 
worked so hard for this! Even I can... If 
it's me...!!!!’"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"‘She's broken through, broken through! 
Orfevre!! —There is no one chasing her 
down!! Orfevre achieves the Triple 
Crown!!!!’"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want you to ever have to feel 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While dealing with all the hustle and 
bustle,
departure time had arrived. Inside 
the car, I was coordinating with Verxina 
on our training camp plans, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It is a milestone leading up to the final 
day, yes? Understood, I have reviewed it. 
There are no issues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her lapse of focus lasted only a moment, 
and Verxina carried herself as dignified 
as ever. However, look closely enough,
and 
traces of fatigue seemed to show...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: Let's iron out the rest once we ge...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I shall get back to studying,
then. Please 
do not hesitate to call out to me if you 
need anything.
choice_data_list: (I really wanted her to rest, thou...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once we arrived at the training camp 
lodging—
choice_data_list: (I really wanted her to get some r...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Gentile-senpai is having a match
race 
with a Senior Class senior!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "No way! Right now!? Let's go watch!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What a shame, to think you were only at 
this level. —Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Guuuugh...!! This can't be... No 
waaaay...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna pulled away from her senior
on 
the straight... and seized victory by an 
overwhelming margin!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "...Now then. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, it has given me even more 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Guhhh... Dammit, dammit, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible... That upperclassman ran in 
the Classic Triple Crown, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And yet, pulling ahead and winning so 
decisively at this point in the Classic 
season... She really is—on a completely 
different level...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I'm so glad we're not in the 
same generation.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ... Truly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
On top of being blessed with incredible 
physical ability, she never slacks off on 
refining it to perfection... It honestly 
makes me sick.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina's stern expression... One look at 
it made it obvious what she was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Regarding the milestone we 
checked earlier...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's raise our target level up another 
notch. I want you to push yourself 
thoroughly to the absolute limit.
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself too ...
I can't let you push yourself too ...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: No.
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself, you...
I can't let you push yourself too ...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This time,
I shall insist on having my own 
way.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Pushing oneself a little is only
natural. 
...This summer will undoubtedly be 
crucial."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The final race of my dream Tiara route... 
I absolutely, positively want to win it!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Please believe in me. ...I will never 
falter, and I will never break!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the heated summer training camp 
had begun!
